line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Renegades.Task.Station
* DESCRIPTION: Runs on the single Renegades Station locat ed in the special Renegades Sector.
* This script keeps the station stocked with renegade ships and manages incursions with these ships
* as well as local defense.
* AUTHOR: Mr Mordan
* DATE: 8 April 2024
* Task 202.
* Wait for starting options to be answered.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Replaced difficulty getter with script call.
* Add-Ons 1.7: The time now scales based on difficulty.
* 4 hours
* 3 hours
* 2 hours
* 1.5 hours
* Player has turned off renegades, so don't do a thing.
* Arm invasion timer once when the gate is unlocked. (Add-Ons 1.7: Renamed 360 timer to invasion timer.)
* 10 minute timer loop. Maintain appropriate number and type of ships based on difficulty level.
* Add-Ons 1.9.4: Increased from 10 minutes to 15 minutes to make up for aggressive scaling.
* Invasion timer loop (only when armed).
* Every X hours (dependent on difficulty), if our gate has been unlocked and if we have enough local ships, send some to greet the player with love and friendship
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Debug instead uses a 10 minute timer.
* Periodically, if the renegade main gate has been uncovered by the player, we will send out half of our local protection force
* to harass random enemy sectors. If the player presence is high enough (about one M7 on high difficulty), we will keep the force in system, but
* if the player backs off or dies then we will send an invasion. Any ships sent will be replaced over time to protect the homeland.
* Get player strength in our system. If it's very high, then don't send out any invasion. An M2 is worth about 500 points. An M6 is worth about 30.
* $flags = [Find.Multiple] | [Find.Nearest]
* $playerShips = find ship: sector=[SECTOR] class or type=null race=[Player] flags=$flags refobj=[THIS] maxdist=300000 maxnum=9999 refpos=null
* Add-Ons 1.7: the danger level is now dynamic. We must get the players' fleet power within the system and our defenders' fleet power.
* Difficulty scales the amount of fleet strength.
* Easy: 40%; normal: 50%; hard: 60%; insane: 75%
* if local player strength is too high, don't send out an invasion, otherwise do.

line.text: 'Invasion Stalled, Player too strong in renegades system. Playerships = %s'

line.comment: * send out half our fleet (must have 10+ homebased ships or more) to spread joy and love with player. bwahhahahahah! developers rule.

line.text: 'The gate is open. A Renegade harassment swarm is being dispatched to cleanse the universe.'

line.comment: * play end-sound effect. laugh or some variant of it.
* TODO: find a better audio?
* this will get picked up in the Renegades.Task.Renegade, forcing the ship to head off towards a random player sector and attack it.

line.text: 'Unable to send invasion, gate is not unlocked'

line.comment: * 10-50 fleet strength (default: 30), determines base number of ships we try to maintain at the station.
* Should never happen. Just in case.
* Add-Ons 1.6.1: The station can now make additional ships based on the player's fleet power.
* Add-Ons 1.9.4: increased scaling thresholds significantly.
* Easy: 1 ship per 625 fleet power; normal: 1 per 500; hard: 1 per 375; insane: 1 per 300. Was previously 200/150/120/90.
* Spawn extra ships at once depending on difficulty. Easy: 1 extra ship per 20 renegade ships; normal: 1 ship per 15; hard: 1 per 12; insane: 1 per 9.
* Add-Ons 1.9.4: Fleet power scaling applies only if the player's fleet power exceeds the power milestone.
* Above fleet power, so scale based on fleet power above milestone.
* No extra fleet power - don't scale.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Easy reduces defenders by 20%. Hard and Insane difficulty increase number of defenders by 20% and 50% respectively. Scales both base and extra.
* Burst budget scales off total strength. Maximum of 15 ships can spawn at once since the station uses an Argon Equipment Dock model, which has 15 M3/M6 docks and 2 capship docks.
* Build 2-15 ships every 10 minutes until we are at, or above strength.
* If player exceeds supply cap, then increase ship difficulty by 1. If 200% or higher, increase by 1 additional tier.
* Clamp. Should never happen anyway but just in case.
* Spawned ship depends on difficulty. Higher difficulties allow it to spawn tougher ships. M7 is more likely the higher the difficulty (base difficulty + up to 2 tiers by scaling).
* Add-Ons 1.2: Pulls from a ship list. (1.6.1 - when an M7 spawns, increment the capship count. A maximum of 2 capital ships may spawn per cycle.)
* Add-Ons 1.6.1: Subroutine is now unused.
* Spawned ship depends on difficulty. Higher difficulties allow it to spawn tougher ships. M7 is more likely the higher the difficulty (base difficulty + up to 2 tiers by scaling).
* Add-Ons 1.2: Pulls from a ship list. (1.6.1 - when an M7 spawns, increment the capship count. A maximum of 2 may spawn per cycle.)
